2610.09914.title: RollVerify: Bridging Efficiency and Accuracy in Long-Tail Rollout Reinforcement Learning
2610.09914.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning is crucial for improving large language models' reasoning and generalization. It relies on massive rollouts whose lengths become increasingly long-tailed as context windows grow. In on-policy training, these long-tail rollouts can result in GPU bubbles, reducing system utilization and limiting RL scalability. Asynchronous or partial-rollout methods improve throughput by relaxing synchronization, but inevitably introduce stale off-policy samples (trajectories) that may hurt final accuracy. Existing approaches mainly mitigate this off-policy issue by reweighting off-policy samples during training, yet they can still leave a performance gap compared to fully on-policy training. In this work, rather than passively reweighting samples during training, we propose RollVerify, a lightweight RL framework built on partial rollout that actively verifies and repairs samples before they enter training. Specifically, it introduces an off-policy shift metric OPS, to quantify the off-policy deviation of partially generated trajectories. Guided by the OPS constraint, RollVerify performs both sequence-level and token-level verification to identify and truncate invalid suffixes of trajectories. This yields high-quality samples that protect the models' accuracy while preserving the efficiency gains of partial rollout. Experiments on mathematical and tool-assisted mathematical reasoning show that RollVerify achieves accuracy comparable to on-policy training while reducing training cost. Additional code-generation results provide preliminary evidence beyond mathematics.
2610.09914.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習對於提升大型語言模型的推理和泛化能力至關重要。它依賴於大量的滾動樣本，隨著上下文窗口的增長，這些樣本的長度變得越來越長尾。在在線策略訓練中，這些長尾滾動樣本可能導致 GPU 泡沫，降低系統利用率並限制強化學習的可擴展性。非同步或部分滾動方法通過放寬同步來提高吞吐量，但不可避免地引入過時的離線樣本（軌跡），這可能會影響最終的準確性。現有的方法主要通過在訓練過程中重新加權離線樣本來減輕這一離線問題，但與完全在線策略訓練相比，仍然可能存在性能差距。在本研究中，我們提出 RollVerify，一個基於部分滾動的輕量級強化學習框架，主動驗證和修復樣本，讓它們在進入訓練之前得到處理，而不是被動地在訓練過程中重新加權。具體而言，它引入了一個離線偏移度量 OPS，用於量化部分生成的軌跡的離線偏差。在 OPS 約束的指導下，RollVerify 執行序列級和標記級的驗證，以識別和截斷無效的軌跡後綴。這產生了高質量的樣本，保護模型的準確性，同時保留部分滾動的效率增益。在數學和工具輔助數學推理的實驗中，RollVerify 的準確性與在線策略訓練相當，同時降低了訓練成本。額外的代碼生成結果提供了超越數學的初步證據。
